data.title: Appointment for the practical driving test
data.summary: Fahrschule Beispielspur informs Johanna Beispielacker that her practical driving test (Klasse B) is scheduled for Thursday, 7 January 2027, with a 07:30 meeting point at the Prüfstelle in Industriestraße 30, Mustergießen; the exam fee was already paid at registration.
data.explanation: Your driving school has booked your practical driving exam for Klasse B on 7 January 2027. Be at the meeting point by 07:30 with your ID card (Personalausweis) — your instructor will pick you up there. You don't need to pay anything else, as the exam fee was already covered when you registered. If you can't make it, contact the driving school as soon as possible to reschedule, since missing the appointment may mean losing the paid fee or needing a new booking.
